# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_reform_build.py -- edit the script, not this file.
# The tenet-reform loop of the Sefer redesign (2026-11-08).

# Scope: the host (event option). Record the motion on him and on the
# sitting, then put it through the synod's shared motion helper.
kehillah_reform_put_motion_effect = {
	involved_activity ?= {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_tenet value = prev.var:kehillah_reform_tenet }
	}
	kehillah_synod_put_motion_effect = { MOTION = flag:tenet_reform }
}

# Scope: the host, at the ruling (kehillah_synod_enact_takkanah_effect).
# Changes the rite's core tenets or the faith's status, refreshes every
# book's ceiling in the faith, and tells the faith's players.
kehillah_reform_enact_effect = {
	save_scope_as = kehillah_reform_host
	faith = { save_scope_as = kehillah_reform_faith }
	custom_tooltip = kehillah_reform_enacted_tt
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:core }
		rite ?= {
			kehillah_reform_remove_core_effect = yes
			kehillah_reform_add_core_effect = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		scope:kehillah_reform_faith = { kehillah_reform_set_status_effect = yes }
	}
	scope:kehillah_reform_faith = {
		every_faith_rite = { kehillah_standing_refresh_ceilings_rite_effect = yes }
	}
	rite ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_reform_pending_tenet ?= prev.var:kehillah_reform_tenet }
			remove_variable = kehillah_reform_pending_tenet
			remove_variable = kehillah_reform_pending_action
		}
	}
	every_player = {
		limit = {
			faith = scope:kehillah_reform_faith
			NOT = { this = scope:kehillah_reform_host }
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_tenet value = scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet days = 60 }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_action value = scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_action days = 60 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_replace }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_replace value = scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_replace days = 60 }
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_kehillah_sefer
			title = kehillah_reform_msg_t
			desc = kehillah_reform_msg_d
			left_icon = scope:kehillah_reform_host
		}
	}
	debug_log = "kehillah_reform_enact_effect: a question of belief was settled"
}

# Scope: the host's rite; reads scope:kehillah_reform_host's choice.
kehillah_reform_add_core_effect = {
	if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 1 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_talmud_torah }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 2 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 3 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 4 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 5 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pesak }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 6 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pilpul }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 7 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 8 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 9 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 10 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_esotericism }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 11 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_asceticism }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:kehillah_reform_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 12 } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_kiddush_hashem }
}

# Scope: a host. Clear his choice once it is settled or abandoned.
kehillah_reform_clear_choice_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_reform_tenet
	remove_variable = kehillah_reform_action
	remove_variable = kehillah_reform_replace
}

# Scope: a rite; from a Machloket's resolution ($KEY$ the disputed work).
# The rite's next gathering is expected to rule on the book's first tenet:
# to raise it after a victory for its defenders, to ban it after a defeat.
kehillah_reform_queue_from_machloket_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_first_tenet_$KEY$ > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_pending_tenet value = kehillah_sefer_first_tenet_$KEY$ years = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_mk_outcome = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_pending_action value = flag:core years = 20 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_reform_pending_action value = flag:ban years = 20 }
		}
	}
}
